slobs.call.description: Sends any Remote Control command to Streamlabs Desktop and gives back its answer. For advanced users. Fails with an error when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

parameters.resource: The part of Streamlabs Desktop to talk to, like "ScenesService" or "StreamingService". Needed.
parameters.method: The command name, like "getScenes" or "toggleStreaming". Needed.
parameters.args: Optional. A list of values the command needs, like ["Gameplay"].

slobs.call.returns: Streamlabs Desktop's answer for that command.
